## Goal

Open the Notifications tab in the Bluesky iOS app (bell icon in the bottom navigation bar) on an iOS Simulator (device UDID: 39000F25-BBC8-474B-9A56-AB28AA9B7438, bundle ID: xyz.blueskyweb.app).

## Instructions

- Use only available tools: POSIX shell, Xcode command-line tools (xcrun, xcodebuild, xctest), and xcrun simctl subcommands
- NO host-level GUI automation available (AppleScript, osascript, System Events not available in this environment)
- The Bluesky app is already installed on the simulator
- Act autonomously without asking questions
- Inspect screen, act, re-inspect in a loop until task is complete

## Discoveries

1. **Deep Link Blocker**: When using `xcrun simctl openurl "bluesky://notifications"`, a system dialog appears asking to confirm opening the link in Bluesky. This dialog cannot be dismissed with available tools.

- Multiple failed attempts to dismiss the dialog using unavailable GUI automation tools
- Successfully sent push notification to the app

- Simulator successfully rebooted and app relaunched
